implemented.title: Dynamic Query Modification for Binary Locality Sensitive Hashing
implemented.note: Round 17: the query is replaced by the l2-normalised centroid <c> of the neighbours found so far. The four results used as the module's grounding, all proved exactly in querymod.test.js — Theorem 1 (maximality of the centroid on sum_{x in S} x.u, with dotProductSum(<c>,S) = ||sum x|| = k||mean||), Theorem 2 (average collision probability, first-order 1/2 + sum x.u/(k pi), maximised at <c>), Appendix C.1 (average residual covariance const - ((sum x.u)/k)^2, minimised at +-<c>), and Section 6.4 (the centroid collides with a member of S on every hyperplane while a raw query need not) — plus the denoising result and the synthetic hash-width crossover. Wired behind the default-off _queryModConfig.

new_leads.title: A Tour of Locality Sensitive Filtering on the Sphere
new_leads.note: Locality-Sensitive Filtering (LSF): asymmetric regions independently control queries and data updates, affording greater expressivity than LSH and a better exponent for angular distance. A self-contained treatment of angular distance under symmetric Gaussian filters on the unit sphere — the canonical setting monotonically equivalent to cosine similarity, i.e. exactly NeuLegion's projection space. The natural next index tier (a filter-based ANN) after the LSH/multi-probe/PCA-aligned stack; would give a different recall-vs-memory tradeoff than `_getGlobalLSHCandidates`.

new_leads.title: Predictive Associative Memory: Retrieval Beyond Similarity Through Temporal Co-occurrence
new_leads.note: Retrieval by temporal co-occurrence rather than representational similarity (a JEPA-style predictor navigates the associative structure). Directly relevant to NeuLegion's episodic/adaptive memory: the bank currently retrieves by projection cosine, but a trading stream's useful memories may be the ones that *followed* a similar state, not the states that look similar. A research direction for the memory-retrieval domain, though it needs a trained predictor (not a pure-function proof).

new_leads.title: Dense Holographic Associative Memories
new_leads.note: Dense Hopfield-style associative recall via a volume-hologram analogy — capacity/denoising theory for the episodic bank. Related to the existing modern-Hopfield grounding (ramsauer2020hopfield).

new_leads.title: Sinkhorn Based Associative Memory Retrieval Using Spherical Hellinger Kantorovich Dynamics
new_leads.note: Dense associative memory over empirical measures (weighted point clouds) with a debiased Sinkhorn/Hopfield energy. A heavier retrieval operator than cosine; recorded for the memory-retrieval domain.

new_leads.title: Positional LSH: Binary Block Matrix Approximation for Attention with Linear Biases
new_leads.note: Attention with positional bias through the LSH lens — relevant to the attention-kernels domain (RoPE / linear-bias attention), not the ANN index.

new_leads.title: 2L-LSH: A Locality-Sensitive Hash Function-Based Method For Rapid Point Cloud Indexing
new_leads.note: A two-level LSH construction for rapid indexing; a candidate index-structure refinement.

new_leads.title: FOLD: Fuzzy Online Deduplication for Very Large Evolving Datasets via Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
new_leads.note: Online dedup where exact-hash equality is replaced by an ANN similarity floor — the fuzzy variant of `_computeContentHash` suppression. Candidate for the memory-write path.
